scene: A medieval woman astronomer still awake on a Gothic castle tower as the first pale dawn reaches the horizon. She studies a new bright star through a simple brass sighting instrument while several candles have burned almost to their bases. Tired but captivated eyes, an unused bed glimpsed through the doorway, a rooster on a distant roof. Convey an entire sleepless night through spent candles and dawn in one coherent scene; no charts with writing or modern telescope.

Travel-weary medieval visitors enjoying an abundant castle feast after a time of scarcity: bread, cheese, fruit and pastries fill a rustic table. One delighted guest discreetly loosens a belt after eating heartily, while others savour their food. Clearly illustrate relishing an opportunity to eat well, not putting on boots. Warm hearth glow, jewel-coloured clothes, cool stone shadows, no labels or text.

An elderly castle resident smiling thoughtfully as he places the fifth small smooth stone into a simple keepsake box. Exactly five separate stones are clearly visible inside the open box, four resting together and the fifth just being lowered. Weathered hands, a quiet Gothic window, a mature tree and old castle masonry beyond suggest years passing. No digits, tally marks or writing. The accompanying vocabulary supplies the five-year meaning; do not show five different panels.

A medieval teacher offering a tangible incentive to tired apprentices cleaning a spacious castle courtyard: she points warmly toward an inviting sunny garden with games beyond the gate, and the apprentices brighten and eagerly resume sweeping to earn their free afternoon. Cleaning tools and a partly swept floor make the task clear. One coherent scene of renewed motivation, warm sunlight and cool Gothic arcade shadows, no written reward notice.

An evasive medieval counsellor speaking at great length with elaborate distracting gestures before an impatient king. The king persistently points toward a locked treasure chest while the counsellor looks away and gestures toward the window instead; courtiers slump wearily as the central question goes unanswered. Candlelit Gothic audience chamber, lapis and crimson fabrics. No literal bird, speech bubbles, written documents, or multi-scene thought cloud.

A weary medieval messenger and horse at the final ridge of a long journey, gazing toward a tiny isolated cabin far beyond successive misty marshes and rugged mountain passes. The cabin is visible but remote, with the last narrow trail fading into wild country. Emphasise extreme distance and difficulty of reaching the destination. Dramatic portrait depth, cool atmospheric layers, a warm glimmer at the cabin. No literal religious figure or lost sandal, no map labels.

An elderly woman lighthouse keeper solemnly handing a burning torch to a young apprentice beside the base of a winding stone stairway leading up to the beacon. Both hold the torch briefly during the transfer; the older keeper's expression is trusting and the apprentice's attentive and responsible. The maritime view and worn lighthouse interior establish the duty being passed on. Warm torchlight against cool sea-blue shadows, no modern equipment or writing.

A teenage medieval squire in a conspicuously splendid new cloak pouting theatrically because nearby companions ignore his display; his mother watches with gentle, knowing patience from a Gothic courtyard doorway. Show immature adolescent self-consciousness through posture and expression, not cruelty. A companion suppresses a smile at the fuss. Jewel-coloured cloak, natural warm light and cool stone. No literal turkey, caricature, inset scenes or written dialogue.

A medieval investigator at a castle kitchen doorway noticing a thin plume of smoke creeping out beneath a closed wooden inner door. He pauses, eyebrows raised in suspicion, while a nervous cook tries to reassure him with open palms. Slightly singed wood near the threshold reinforces that something is wrong without showing a major blaze. Warm kitchen candlelight, cool smoky shadows, no detective magnifier, labels or written clues.

A medieval traveller searching for a dropped ordinary glove beside a castle garden path accidentally uncovering a beautiful old jewelled brooch beneath a loose stone. The glove remains plainly visible nearby while the traveller lifts the unexpected treasure with delighted surprise. Make the contrast between the humble search and fortunate discovery clear in one coherent scene. Rich painterly foliage, Gothic arches, warm late sunlight, cool mossy shadows, no letters or modern objects.
